newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 13.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
* Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc struck a deal to buy LIN Television station group for $1.7 billion in cash plus assumption of debt.
* NBC won the August 4-10 primetime Nielsens race, but with a slim margin of victory.
* Michael Flatley, the popular Irish dancer, left International Creative Management and signed with Creative Artists Agency.
* Preston Padden, president of the ABC abc.L TV Network, said multichannel digital television could be a reality sooner than many analysts are predicting.
* The Writers Guild of America announced Tuesday that it had reached a tentative agreement for a new three-year contract with film and television producers.

* The Directors Guild of America is investigating Paramount Pictures' comedy "A Night at the Roxbury," following reports that its writer-producer Amy Heckerling was acting as the director on the film even though it already had a helmer in Peter Markle. (--New York newsroom 212-859-1700)
